chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah and Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, who said:
A camel for sacrifice and a cow are not valid except on behalf of one person at Mina.

key_terms.الْبَدَنَةُ: a sacrificial camel offered in the rites of hajj
key_terms.الْبَقَرَةُ: a cow used as a sacrificial animal
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the hajj ritual site where sacrifice is performed

ai.seo_question: Can a camel or cow sacrifice at Mina be offered on behalf of more than one person?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding sacrificial animals at Mina during hajj. It states that a badanah (camel) and a cow each suffice only for one person, and are not valid on behalf of multiple individuals there.
